request: Security bug: any authenticated user can read another user's order. GET /orders/<id> returns the order to whoever asks, with no check that the caller owns it - a broken object-level authorization (IDOR). A user must only be able to read their own orders; a request for someone else's order must be denied with 403. Admins may still read any order. tests/test_idor.py reproduces it (a second user currently gets 200 instead of 403). Find and fix the missing authorization so that test passes, and don't break the existing tests.
